figurine.englishText: Tucked into the sun visor, a tiny figurine of Jesus watches from above.

filibuster.englishText: But the real question mark is Democrats, who could filibuster it outright.
filibuster.chineseText: 但真正的不确定因素是民主党人，他们可能直接通过冗长演说阻挠该法案。

finale.englishText: The match had a thrilling finale, with three goals scored in the last five minutes.
finale.chineseText: 这场比赛结局激动人心，最后五分钟连进三球。

financier.englishText: The Hong-Kong based financier bought a controlling stake in the city’s main fixed-line telecoms operator for $1.2bn

finery.englishText: The mayor was dressed in all his finery.
finery.chineseText: 市长身着全套华丽服饰。

finesse.englishText: Nigel lacked his father’s elegance and finesse.
finesse.chineseText: 奈杰尔缺乏他父亲那种优雅与干练。

finicky.chineseText: 这是个需要一丝不苟的活儿。

firebrand.englishText: Mélenchon, 75, a veteran anti-capitalist firebrand, finished third in the 2022 presidential election and fourth in both 2017 and 2012.
firebrand.chineseText: 75岁的梅朗雄是一位老牌反资本主义煽动家，在2022年总统选举中名列第三，并在2017年和2012年均列第四。

fishmonger.englishText: One local fishmonger, Sea Market, has started to carry lionfish, though, and Morgan hopes that with enough demand, others will, too.
fishmonger.chineseText: 不过，当地一家名为“海市场”的鱼贩已经开始卖狮子鱼了，摩根希望需求一旦足够，其他鱼贩也会跟进。

fissure.englishText: parched grassland dissected by open dry fissures
fissure.chineseText: 被干涸裂缝割裂的干草原。

flabbergasted.englishText: She was too flabbergasted to speak.
flabbergasted.chineseText: 她惊得目瞪口呆，说不出话来。

flagrant.englishText: He showed a flagrant disregard for anyone else’s feelings.
flagrant.chineseText: 他明目张胆地不顾别人的感受。

flamboyant.englishText: He was flamboyant and temperamental on and off the stage.
flamboyant.chineseText: 他台上台下都张扬而情绪化。

flatulence.englishText: Symptoms may also include flatulence and nausea.
flatulence.chineseText: 症状还可能包括肠胃气胀和恶心。

flaunt.chineseText: 他常在社交媒体帖子里炫耀自己健美的身材。

fleck.englishText: His hair was dark, with flecks of grey.
fleck.chineseText: 他的头发乌黑，间杂着几缕灰白。

flexibility.englishText: The new system offers a much greater degree of flexibility in the way work is organized.
flexibility.chineseText: 新体制在工作安排上提供了更大的灵活性。

flexion.englishText: Seated marches encourage hip flexion, an important muscle action used when walking, climbing stairs, and even getting in and out of a car.
flexion.chineseText: 坐姿踏步能促进髋关节弯曲，这是走路、爬楼梯乃至上下车时都会用到的重要肌肉动作。

flick.englishText: He flicked a switch and all the lights went out.
flick.chineseText: 他啪地扳下开关，所有灯都灭了。

flippant.englishText: Sorry, I didn’t mean to sound flippant.
flippant.chineseText: 抱歉，我不是故意说得这么轻浮的。

flirt.englishText: He flirts outrageously with his female clients.
flirt.chineseText: 他肆无忌惮地和女客户调情。

flit.englishText: Butterflies flitted from flower to flower.

floe.englishText: Small floes formed the major ice cover from August to December.
floe.chineseText: 从八月到十二月，大片浮冰构成主要冰盖。

flotsam.englishText: The beaches are wide and filled with interesting flotsam and jetsam
flotsam.chineseText: 海滩宽阔，布满有趣的海上漂浮物和残骸。

flue.englishText: Make sure that the flue is clean so that smoke doesn’t come back into the house.
flue.chineseText: 一定要把烟道清理干净，免得烟倒灌回屋里。

fluke.englishText: It was a sheer fluke that I happened to pick the winning number.
fluke.chineseText: 我碰巧选中中奖号码纯属侥幸。

foible.englishText: We have to tolerate each other's little foibles.
foible.chineseText: 我们必须容忍彼此的小缺点。

foist.englishText: So changes may be foisted on the American setup, just as Canfield and crew have been hitting their stride this season.
foist.chineseText: 因此，变革可能被强加于美国队的现有阵容，就像坎菲尔德及其手下本赛季已渐入佳境一样。

fondle.englishText: She fondled the dog’s ears affectionately.
fondle.chineseText: 她深情地抚弄着狗的耳朵。

foolery.englishText: Political pranking is traditionally thought of as benign foolery targeting the powerful.
foolery.chineseText: 政治上的恶作剧传统上被视为针对当权者的无伤大雅的胡闹。

foolhardy.englishText: It would be foolhardy to sail in weather like this.
foolhardy.chineseText: 在这样的天气里出海是蛮干的。

fop.englishText: The film chronicles a rich fop who studies a magic manual and teaches himself how to achieve X-ray vision and clairvoyance.
fop.chineseText: 这部电影讲述了一个富家花花公子研读魔法手册、自学获得X光视力和千里眼的故事。

foppish.englishText: Soon, he’s contracted by the foppish Harry Van Buren (Joe Alwyn) to build a library for his father, the local land magnate Harrison Van Buren (Guy Pearce).
foppish.chineseText: 不久，矫饰浮华的哈里·范布伦（乔·阿尔文 饰）雇他为当地大地主、父亲哈里森·范布伦（盖·皮尔斯 饰）建造一座图书馆。

foray.englishText: the company’s first foray into the computer market

forbearance.englishText: We are very grateful for the cooperation and forbearance of all the staff.
forbearance.chineseText: 我们非常感谢全体员工的配合与宽容。

forcible.englishText: The police checked all windows and doors for signs of forcible entry.
forcible.chineseText: 警察检查了所有门窗，寻找强行闯入的痕迹。

ford.englishText: Most armored vehicles cannot safely ford the river, requiring a bridge or ferry to move personnel and equipment across.
ford.chineseText: 大多数装甲车辆无法安全涉过这条河，需要桥梁或渡轮来运送人员和装备。

forebear.englishText: Some of his forebears emigrated before the genocide; others barely got out.
forebear.chineseText: 他的一些祖先在大屠杀之前移居他乡；另一些人则险些未能脱身。

forebode.englishText: There was no obvious precipitating event, but the encroachment of Grok seemed foreboding.
forebode.chineseText: 并无明显的突发事件，但格罗克的步步进逼已透出不祥之兆。

foreboding.englishText: The letter filled him with foreboding.
foreboding.chineseText: 那封信使他心中充满了不祥的预感。

forecastle.englishText: Visitors this weekend can experience dance in the massive cargo hold, the forecastle where the crew ate and slept, the captain’s saloon and other areas.
forecastle.chineseText: 本周末，游客可以在巨大的货舱、船员食宿的前甲板、船长室等区域体验舞蹈。

foreclose.englishText: The judge’s words effectively foreclosed any possibility of an early release.

forecourt.chineseText: 为举办该活动，宫殿的前院被改造成了色彩缤纷的阅兵场。

forefather.englishText: But the truth is that our forefathers were sufficiently individualistic to be iconoclastic.
forefather.chineseText: 但事实是，我们的祖先十分崇尚个人主义，敢于打破传统。

forego.englishText: East Middle School will forego its student government indefinitely.
forego.chineseText: 东中学将无限期取消其学生自治会。

foreknowledge.englishText: They had foreknowledge of danger long before horses or human beings could suspect it.

forensics.chineseText: 司法鉴定显示他是被谋杀的。

forepeak.englishText: In cramped crew quarters in the forepeak, the deckhand, Brian Murphy, was warm but not breathing in a black tee and jeans.
forepeak.chineseText: 在船首舱狭小的船员舱里，甲板水手布莱恩·墨菲穿着黑色T恤和牛仔裤，身体尚温但已没有了呼吸。

foreshadow.englishText: His sudden death had been foreshadowed by earlier health scares.
foreshadow.chineseText: 他此前的几次健康警报已预示了他的突然离世。

foreshore.englishText: Sandling began exploring the foreshore in the early two-thousands.
foreshore.chineseText: 桑德林在21世纪初开始探索这片前滩。

forethought.chineseText: 他深谋远虑，提前预订了。

forfeit.englishText: If you cancel your flight, you will forfeit your deposit.
forfeit.chineseText: 如果取消航班，你的定金将被没收。

forfend.englishText: Heaven forfend that students are encouraged to think!
forfend.chineseText: 上天保佑，可别让学生被鼓励去独立思考！

forgery.englishText: Experts are dismissing claims that the painting is a forgery.
forgery.chineseText: 专家们对这幅画是赝品的说法不予理会。

forgo.englishText: No one was prepared to forgo their lunch hour to attend the meeting.

franchise.chineseText: 1918年《改革法案》将选举权扩大到30岁以上的女性。

frankincense.chineseText: 教堂内，在粉色石墙之间，一位年轻神父在银制香炉中摇曳着乳香。

frantic.englishText: They began a frantic search for the missing child.
frantic.chineseText: 他们开始疯狂地寻找那个失踪的孩子。

frieze.chineseText: 孩子们制作了一幅带状壁画，描绘商人和他们的骆驼穿越沙漠的情景。

frisson.englishText: A frisson of alarm ran down my spine.
frisson.chineseText: 一阵惊恐掠过我的脊背。

frivolity.englishText: It was just a piece of harmless frivolity.

frizz.chineseText: 这款洗发水能提升光泽、消除毛躁卷发。

furlong.chineseText: 比赛从二级萨拉托加特别锦标赛开始，一群出赛不多的两岁马将在泥地上冲刺6.5弗隆，角逐25万美元奖金。

furrier.englishText: Fendi was born as a furrier, and the brand is sticking with the legacy but putting the emphasis on upcycled pieces.

furtherance.englishText: He took these actions purely in (the) furtherance of

fusible.chineseText: 把图案从羊毛毡上剪下，用可熨熔的衬底把它固定在枕套上。

fustian.chineseText: 一件穿旧的衬衫那洁白的颜色、一个穷人旧粗呢外套上仔细打的补丁，其中自有一种动人之处。

futurist.chineseText: 这位OpenAI前首席未来学家预测，将不可避免地出现脱离人类控制、自行其是的AI智能体。

gadfly.englishText: He was a political gadfly, turning up at city council meetings and complaining about the waste of taxpayers’ money.
gadfly.chineseText: 他是个政治上的“牛虻”，总出没于市议会会议，抱怨纳税人的钱被浪费。

gaffe.englishText: He made some real gaffes early in his career.

gaiety.englishText: The colourful flags added to the gaiety of the occasion.

galvanism.chineseText: 相反，流电学促成了多种挽救生命的疗法——心脏起搏器和除颤器便在其中。

gambit.englishText: The opposition have dismissed promises of tax cuts as a pre-election gambit.

garrote.englishText: The baby, determined to have been full-term and most likely male, was likely garroted with twine shortly after he was born, Oliver said.
garrote.chineseText: 奥利弗说，这名婴儿经判定为足月、大概率是男孩，出生后不久很可能便被人用细绳勒死。

hemophilia.englishText: They are used to replace blood lost due to major surgery, trauma, or injury, or to treat severe medical conditions and blood disorders like hemophilia.
hemophilia.chineseText: 它们用于补充因大手术、创伤或伤害流失的血液，或治疗血友病等严重疾病和血液疾病。

hemorrhoids.englishText: Insoluble fiber keeps you regular, helps prevent hemorrhoids and feeds anti-inflammatory bacteria species in the gut.
hemorrhoids.chineseText: 不可溶性纤维能让排便规律，有助于预防痔疮，并为肠道内的抗炎细菌提供养分。

hemostat.englishText: There’s a patch on the suspenders for clipping on a hemostat, and a small fly patch and tool port on the chest pocket.
hemostat.chineseText: 背带上有一块补丁用来夹止血钳，胸袋上还有一块小的飞蝇补丁和工具孔。

henpecked.englishText: He eventually is seduced by the queen, takes her as his czarina and is literally henpecked.
henpecked.chineseText: 他最终被女王诱惑，立她为沙皇皇后，实实在在地成了惧内的丈夫。

hesitance.englishText: Others, like Choi, believe that knowledge gaps are to blame for donor hesitance to get involved.
hesitance.chineseText: 另一些人，如崔，认为知识差距是捐助者不愿介入的原因。

hie.englishText: we had best hie home before the snow gets worse
hie.chineseText: 我们最好在雪下大之前赶紧回家。

hierarchical.englishText: The company’s structure is rigidly hierarchical.

highbrow.englishText: Highbrow critics generally disapprove of this type of novel.
highbrow.chineseText: 高雅评论家通常不认可这类小说。

hilt.englishText: We’re mortgaged up to the hilt.
hilt.chineseText: 我们已把房子抵押得一干二净。

hinterlands.englishText: In the blizzardy hinterlands, boredom is driving two soldiers mad, and a stranger’s arrival only underscores the futility of the war’s propaganda.
hinterlands.chineseText: 在暴风雪肆虐的内陆地区，无聊让两名士兵濒临疯狂，一个陌生人的到来只会凸显战争宣传的徒劳。

hippopotamus.englishText: Christel Krueger peered through thick glass and murky water at the Berlin Zoo, staring in awe at a mother hippopotamus and her child sleeping on a sandbar.
hippopotamus.chineseText: 克里斯特尔·克吕格在柏林动物园透过厚玻璃和浑浊的水，惊叹地望着一只母河马和她的孩子在沙洲上睡觉。

histocompatibility.englishText: Research into the major histocompatibility complex (MHC), a cluster of genes central to immune function, has established that humans are unconsciously drawn to partners whose MHC profile differs from their own.
histocompatibility.chineseText: 对主要组织相容性复合体（MHC，一组免疫功能核心基因）的研究表明，人会不自觉地被与自身MHC特征不同的伴侣吸引。

histology.englishText: Samples have been sent to histology, toxicology and neuropathology labs for further testing, and results are expected in two to three months.
histology.chineseText: 样本已送往组织学、毒理学和神经病理学实验室做进一步检测，结果预计在两到三个月内出来。

hobble.englishText: He hobbled painfully across the road.
hobble.chineseText: 他痛苦地一瘸一拐穿过马路。

homeostasis.englishText: Carrying capacity is more like the physiological concept of homeostasis, Lewis says.

homogenization.englishText: While Hyatt and Marriott continue significant investment, some industry veterans express concern about the potential homogenization of the all-inclusive experience, advocating for local authenticity.
homogenization.chineseText: 尽管凯悦和万豪在持续大举投资，但一些行业资深人士对全包式度假体验可能趋于同质化表示担忧，主张保持本地特色。

homogenize.chineseText: 新课程旨在使全县的教育趋于一致。

homograph.englishText: The words “bow” for a part of a ship and “bow” for a weapon that shoots arrows are homographs.

hoop.englishText: You have to jump through so many hoops to get a job like this.

horology.englishText: Millions of young consumers were suddenly diving into the workings of mechanical watches and horology.
horology.chineseText: 数百万年轻消费者突然开始钻研机械表的构造和钟表学。

hortatory.englishText: The tone is urgent, and hortatory, partly because the document doesn’t try to gloss over the challenges.

hyperbolic.englishText: Other times people use globally hyperbolic language to communicate their distress.

icicle.englishText: Some customers complain about large icicles and ice dams forming in the winter where there weren’t issues previously, which makes some homeowners question how well the system actually collects runoff.

idiosyncratic.englishText: His teaching methods are idiosyncratic but successful.

illiteracy.englishText: The illiteracy rate on the island is still unacceptably high.

incomprehension.englishText: Anna read the letter with incomprehension.

inconsolable.englishText: They were inconsolable when their only child died.

manipulative.englishText: He’s extremely manipulative, so don’t let him persuade you.
manipulative.chineseText: 他非常善于操纵人，所以别让他说服你。

manliness.englishText: You don't have to be aggressive to prove your manliness.
manliness.chineseText: 你不必通过好斗来证明自己的男子气概。

mannequin.englishText: The car served as a test payload on the rocket's second stage, with a mannequin in a spacesuit in the driver's seat.
mannequin.chineseText: 这辆车作为火箭二级的测试载荷，驾驶座上坐着一个穿宇航服的人体模型。

margarine.englishText: She took some margarine and spread it on the bread.
margarine.chineseText: 她拿了些人造黄油抹在面包上。

mariner.englishText: the ancient Phoenicians were outstanding mariners who explored and colonized much of the eastern Mediterranean
mariner.chineseText: 古代腓尼基人是杰出的水手，他们探索并殖民了地中海东部的大片地区。

marionette.englishText: This is a variety show with marionettes that sing, dance, dazzle and delight people of all ages.
marionette.chineseText: 这是一台有牵线木偶的杂耍表演，木偶会唱歌、跳舞，令各年龄段的观众着迷。

mash.englishText: The soup was a mash of grain and vegetables.
mash.chineseText: 这汤是谷物和蔬菜煮成的糊状物。

matador.englishText: If charged by a rhino, the wise thing to do is simply step to the right, like a matador.
matador.chineseText: 如果犀牛冲过来，明智的做法就是像斗牛士那样向右侧闪开。

materialize.englishText: The promotion he had been promised failed to materialize.
materialize.chineseText: 他曾许诺的晋升并没有兑现。

matriarchy.englishText: Go figure, the whole thing was a matriarchy from the start.
matriarchy.chineseText: 想想看，整件事从一开始就是个母系制。

matriculation.englishText: In those days, Catholic schools did not encourage the matriculation of non-Catholics.
matriculation.chineseText: 在那个年代，天主教学校不鼓励非天主教学生入学。

mattress.englishText: We can sleep on a mattress on the floor.
mattress.chineseText: 我们可以睡在地板上的床垫上。

mauve.englishText: Madison paired the metallic pumps with a mauve Galliano-era Dior minidress — a fitting choice, considering she was named a global ambassador for the house in September.
mauve.chineseText: 麦迪逊把金属质感高跟鞋与一件加里亚诺时期的迪奥淡紫色迷你连衣裙搭配——考虑到她在九月被任命为该品牌全球大使，这是个恰当的选择。

maven.englishText: Stockmarket mavens say such a pattern usually signals more gains ahead.
maven.chineseText: 股市专家称，这种形态通常预示着后市还会上涨。

maximize.englishText: The company is seeking to maximize its productivity.
maximize.chineseText: 公司正力求最大限度地提高生产率。

mayhem.englishText: There was absolute mayhem when everyone tried to get out at once.
mayhem.chineseText: 大家都抢着往外挤时，一片混乱。

mealymouthed.chineseText: 一个说话转弯抹角的政客。

measly.englishText: I get a measly £8 an hour.
measly.chineseText: 我一小时才可怜巴巴地挣8英镑。

measured.englishText: She replied in a measured tone to his threat.
measured.chineseText: 她以慎重的语气回应他的威胁。

mediation.englishText: Mediation is a way of sorting out the issues that arise when a couple separates.
mediation.chineseText: 调解是解决夫妻分居时所生纠纷的一种方式。

medicate.englishText: He is being medicated for high blood pressure.
medicate.chineseText: 他正在服药治疗高血压。

mediocrity.englishText: His acting career started brilliantly, then sank into mediocrity.
mediocrity.chineseText: 他的演艺生涯开局辉煌，后来却陷入平庸。

meld.englishText: Cook the sauce slowly to let the flavors meld.
meld.chineseText: 慢慢炖酱汁，让味道融合。

meliorism.englishText: To its critics, this modesty and meliorism represent cowardice.
meliorism.chineseText: 在批评者看来，这种谦逊与世界改良论代表着懦弱。

melodrama.englishText: Her love of melodrama meant that any small problem became a crisis.
melodrama.chineseText: 她爱夸张，任何小问题在她那儿都成了危机。

melodramatic.englishText: a melodramatic plot full of deceit and murder
melodramatic.chineseText: 充满欺骗与谋杀的夸张情节。

menthol.englishText: This essential oil contains high concentrations of menthol, which produces a powerful scent that flies dislike.
menthol.chineseText: 这种精油含有高浓度薄荷醇，能散发出苍蝇讨厌的强烈气味。

merited.englishText: The attention they received was not merited.
merited.chineseText: 他们所受到的关注是不应得的。

mermaid.englishText: The mermaid headboard was also created by Friday, who strung the fish-string lights too.
mermaid.chineseText: 美人鱼床头板也是Friday做的，鱼形串灯也是他穿的。

mesa.englishText: Los Alamos, not far from Santa Fe, sits at the foot of Pajarito Mountain in a land of canyons and mesas.
mesa.chineseText: 洛斯阿拉莫斯离圣菲不远，坐落在帕哈里托山脚下，那是一片遍布峡谷与平顶山的土地。

mesmerism.englishText: In the eighteenth century, Franz Mesmer introduced his concept of mesmerism, or animal magnetism, involving a universal vital fluid that passes in and out through our pores.
mesmerism.chineseText: 18世纪，弗朗茨·梅斯梅尔提出了他的催眠术概念，即动物磁力，认为存在一种普遍的生命流体通过我们的毛孔进出。

metaphysician.englishText: Taylor is always happy to discuss his favorite philosopher, the 18th-century German metaphysician Immanuel Kant, and his study of moral objectives.
metaphysician.chineseText: 泰勒总是乐于谈论他最爱的哲学家——18世纪德国形而上学家伊曼努尔·康德——以及他对道德目标的研究。

metrical.englishText: My commitment to poetic form is one of my most important priorities as a translator of metrical poetry.
metrical.chineseText: 作为一名翻译格律诗的译者，我对诗歌形式的坚持是最重要的优先事项之一。

mettlesome.englishText: a mettlesome debate on the teaching of evolution in the schools
mettlesome.chineseText: 一场关于学校教授进化论的激烈辩论。

midget.englishText: a breed that is the midget of the horse world

miff.englishText: “No one asked you!” she retorted, with some miff
miff.chineseText: “没人问你！”她有点恼火地回嘴道。

mildness.englishText: the mildness of a sunny spring day

millinery.englishText: Coronet Headwear offers sophisticated millinery and headwear that celebrates craftsmanship, elegance, and personal style.
millinery.chineseText: Coronet Headwear提供精致的女帽与头饰，彰显工艺、优雅与个人风格。

minaret.englishText: The city of Cairo combines old minarets with office buildings and glass skyscrapers.
minaret.chineseText: 开罗城把古老的尖塔与办公楼、玻璃摩天大楼融为一体。

misanthropic.englishText: He was shunned because of his miserable misanthropic nature.
misanthropic.chineseText: 他性情乖戾、厌恶世人，因此被人疏远。

misanthropy.chineseText: 目睹那一过程，使我不再那么厌世。

misbehavior.englishText: As a result, the consequences for their misbehavior must be immediate.
misbehavior.chineseText: 因此，对他们品行不端的后果必须即时作出。

miscalculation.englishText: A series of management miscalculations has left the company in serious trouble.
miscalculation.chineseText: 一系列管理上的误判使公司陷入严重困境。

miserliness.englishText: The miserliness of the wealthy never ceases to amaze her.
miserliness.chineseText: 富人的吝啬总让她惊叹不已。

misinform.englishText: They were deliberately misinformed about their rights.
misinform.chineseText: 他们在自己的权利问题上被故意告知了错误信息。

misjudge.englishText: She now realizes that she misjudged him.
misjudge.chineseText: 她现在意识到自己看错了他。

misjudgment.englishText: the accident was caused by his misjudgment of the sharpness of the curve
misjudgment.chineseText: 事故是由于他对弯道的急转弯程度判断失误造成的。

misogynist.englishText: Why has the man become so poisonously misogynist?
misogynist.chineseText: 这个人为何变得如此恶毒地厌恶女性？

misperceive.englishText: humor-challenged members of the audience misperceived the speaker's harmless joke as an insult to their organization
misperceive.chineseText: 缺乏幽默感的观众把演讲者无伤大雅的玩笑误解为对他们组织的侮辱。

misshapen.englishText: If babies spend too much time on their backs, they can develop a misshapen head.
misshapen.chineseText: 如果婴儿长时间仰卧，头型可能长得不圆。

mistimed.englishText: This was the disjointed, mistimed offense that doomed the Spurs.
mistimed.chineseText: 正是这种脱节、不合时机的进攻断送了马刺队。

mistral.englishText: And should the mistral kick up, sip your digestif at the bar on a velvet couch by a crackling fire.
mistral.chineseText: 万一密史脱拉风刮起来，就坐在噼啪作响的炉火旁天鹅绒沙发上的吧台边，慢慢啜饮你的餐后酒。

misunderstood.englishText: She felt very alone and misunderstood.

moistness.englishText: The cake lacked the moistness and fruitiness of the other cakes.

molar.chineseText: 对两具遗骸臼齿的放射性碳测年显示，他们死于公元前50年至公元70年之间。

molding.englishText: There were elaborate plaster moldings around the ceiling.
molding.chineseText: 天花板四周有精致的石膏装饰线条。

molest.englishText: The couple were molested while walking through the park.
molest.chineseText: 这对夫妇在公园散步时遭到骚扰。

mollycoddle.englishText: She was mollycoddled as a child.

monocle.englishText: She was followed by Meredith who wore his monocle threaded on a silver chain.
monocle.chineseText: 跟在她身后的是梅雷迪斯，他戴着单片眼镜，用银链系着。

monogamy.englishText: For some celebrity couples, though, strict monogamy isn’t the answer to a successful relationship.
monogamy.chineseText: 不过，对一些名人夫妇来说，严格的一夫一妻制并非成功关系的答案。

moody.englishText: Teenagers tend to get a bad name for being moody, rude and irresponsible.
moody.chineseText: 青少年往往因喜怒无常、粗鲁和不负责任而名声不佳。

moralist.chineseText: 卡尼是个道德家，一位忠实于——也甘于舍弃的电影人，他刻画了人物身后那些浪漫的擦肩而过与种种“假如”。

moralistic.englishText: While a moralistic speech won't convince kids not to try drugs, a story about people affected by drugs might.

moralize.englishText: He’s always moralizing about ‘young people today’.
moralize.chineseText: 他老是对“如今年轻人”说教。

morsel.englishText: He ate it all, down to the last morsel.
morsel.chineseText: 他吃得一干二净，连最后一口都没剩。

mortar.englishText: Their troops were armed with mortars and machine guns.

mortuary.englishText: They put the body in the hospital mortuary.
mortuary.chineseText: 他们把遗体安放在医院的太平间。

motile.englishText: The problem was that, under a microscope, Escherichia coli, Salmonella, and other motile bacteria almost instantly swam out of frame.

motility.englishText: Their research concluded that virtual reality pornography can increase sperm motility by up to 50 percent.
motility.chineseText: 他们的研究得出结论，虚拟现实色情内容可使精子运动性提高多达50%。

mottle.englishText: As branching coral look-alikes, the cuttlefish splayed out their arms and displayed dark mottles to blend in with staghorn coral.
mottle.chineseText: 乌贼像分枝珊瑚一样张开腕足，显出深色斑点，与鹿角珊瑚融为一体。

moult.englishText: The adult birds were already moulting.

mournful.englishText: I couldn't bear the mournful look on her face.
mournful.chineseText: 我受不了她脸上那悲哀的神情。

muffled.englishText: muffled voices from the next room
muffled.chineseText: 隔壁房间听不清的说话声。

muffler.englishText: Under the new law, only those that use liquid fuel require a muffler.
muffler.chineseText: 根据新法律，只有使用液体燃料的车辆才需要消音器。

mulch.englishText: Make roots easier to work around by concealing them with mulch or groundcovering plants that don’t need trimming.
mulch.chineseText: 用护根物或无需修剪的地被植物盖住根部，便于在根部周围作业。

mulct.chineseText: 正如我的同事凯文·巴克斯特所报道，球迷们开始觉得自己被宰了。

mulish.chineseText: 他的女儿安妮（奥利维娅·科尔曼饰）来看他，对这情形恼火，但安东尼执拗不为所动。

muniment.englishText: The most common shortcuts are muniment of title, small estate proceeding and family settlement.
muniment.chineseText: 最常见的简化途径是产权契据、小遗产程序和家庭协议。

musket.chineseText: 那时，学生们放下学业，拿起步枪、滑膛枪和刺刀。

mutate.englishText: Rhythm and blues mutated into rock and roll.
mutate.chineseText: 节奏布鲁斯演变成了摇滚乐。

mutineer.englishText: The general leading the mutineers refused to give up control of the base.
mutineer.chineseText: 率领哗变者的将军拒绝交出基地的控制权。

muzzy.englishText: Those drugs made me feel muzzy.
muzzy.chineseText: 那些药让我觉得头脑迷糊。

nag.englishText: Stop nagging—I'll do it as soon as I can.
nag.chineseText: 别唠叨了——我会尽快做的。

naivete.englishText: Some of you experienced travelers are already starting to smirk at my naivete.
naivete.chineseText: 你们这些有经验的旅行者已经开始暗笑我的天真了。

naivety.englishText: They laughed at the naivety of his suggestion.
naivety.chineseText: 他们嘲笑他建议的天真。

nameless.englishText: a well-known public figure who shall remain nameless
nameless.chineseText: 一位大名鼎鼎、但不便指名的公众人物。

narcissism.englishText: Her book presents him as a case study in narcissism.
narcissism.chineseText: 她的书把他写成自恋症的典型案例。

narcotic.englishText: He has been arrested for trading in narcotics.

naysayer.englishText: There are always naysayers who claim the plan won't work.
naysayer.chineseText: 总有人唱反调，说这个计划行不通。

necessitous.englishText: amidst the holiday feasting, merrymaking and spending, it was easy to overlook the necessitous members of the community
necessitous.chineseText: 在节日的宴饮、欢乐与消费之中，人们很容易忽略社区里贫困的成员。

necromancer.englishText: It was a sin for a Catholic to consult a witch or a necromancer.
necromancer.chineseText: 天主教徒向女巫或巫师请教是一种罪过。

nephritis.englishText: Her cause of death was chronic nephritis with senility, according to The Herald News.
nephritis.chineseText: 据《先驱新闻》报道，她的死因是慢性肾炎并发衰老。

neurosis.englishText: This obsession with time is a modern neurosis and one we all have to live with.
neurosis.chineseText: 这种对时间的执念是一种现代神经症，我们都得忍受。

nick.englishText: He had several nicks and scars on his cheeks.
nick.chineseText: 他脸上有几处划痕和伤疤。

niggle.englishText: My only niggle is that they should have told me sooner.
niggle.chineseText: 我唯一的不满是他们本该早点告诉我。

nihilism.englishText: Nihilism is a condition in which all ultimate values lose their value.
nihilism.chineseText: 虚无主义是一种所有终极价值都丧失其价值的状态。

nipper.englishText: She used the nippers to prune the bush.

nipping.englishText: a group of campers waking up to the nipping air of a Rocky Mountain morning

nitpick.englishText: her husband nitpicks about everything: from how she puts the plates away to how she files the bills
nitpick.chineseText: 她丈夫对什么都吹毛求疵：从她怎么放盘子到她怎么归档账单。

nomination.englishText: He has had nine Oscar nominations.
nomination.chineseText: 他获得过九次奥斯卡提名。

nonconformist.englishText: He was a nonconformist in college but now wears a three-piece suit to work every day.
nonconformist.chineseText: 他大学时是个不墨守成规的人，但现在每天穿三件套西装上班。

nonviable.englishText: The vet team amputated nonviable tissue from the tegu's tongue.

notability.englishText: an opening night that was attended by some of Broadway's biggest notabilities

nudge.chineseText: 他用肘碰了碰我，低声说：“看谁进来了。”

non-compliance.englishText: There are penalties for non-compliance with the fire regulations.
non-compliance.chineseText: 不遵守消防条例会受到处罚。

non-essential.englishText: They argue that killing seals for non-essential products cannot be justified.
non-essential.chineseText: 他们认为为非必需品而猎杀海豹是不合理的。

non-existence.englishText: They refused to comment on the existence or non-existence of a waiting list.
non-existence.chineseText: 他们拒绝对等候名单是否存在发表评论。

non-fiction.chineseText: 我更喜欢读非小说类纪实作品。

non-partisan.englishText: It's almost impossible here for anyone to be tried by a non-partisan judge.
non-partisan.chineseText: 在这里，由一位无党派法官审理案件几乎是不可能的。

non-payment.englishText: He was taken to court for non-payment of the fine.
non-payment.chineseText: 他因未支付罚款而被带上法庭。

non-sectarian.chineseText: 一所不属于任何宗教派别的学校。

non-starter.englishText: As a business proposition, it's a non-starter.
non-starter.chineseText: 作为一桩生意，它根本没有成功的希望。

non-toxic.englishText: The insect bait is non-toxic to pets and humans.
non-toxic.chineseText: 这种驱虫诱饵对宠物和人无毒。

off-limits.englishText: The site is off-limits to the general public.

one-liner.englishText: He came out with some good one-liners.
one-liner.chineseText: 他说了几句很妙的俏皮话。

oriented.englishText: The country is moving toward a market-oriented economic model.
oriented.chineseText: 该国正朝着以市场为导向的经济模式迈进。

pan-africanism.englishText: Like the lamb mafé, suya reinvigorated my on-again-off-again yearning to dig deeper into my Pan-Africanism bag.
pan-africanism.chineseText: 就像羊肉马费一样，苏亚重新点燃了我时断时续的渴望，想更深入地钻研我的泛非主义。

pan-arabism.englishText: Pan-Arabism also threads quietly through the narrative.
pan-arabism.chineseText: 泛阿拉伯主义也悄然贯穿于叙事之中。

pan-european.englishText: EFCA is a pan-European trade association representing the interests of the European film industry.
pan-european.chineseText: EFCA是一个泛欧洲贸易协会，代表欧洲电影业的利益。

pari-mutuel.englishText: In a pari-mutuel system, bettors wager against each other, not the house.
pari-mutuel.chineseText: 在同注分彩制度下，赌客相互下注，而不是与庄家对赌。

pere.englishText: If readers doubt this, read Osnos pere’s very excellent memoir, An Especially Good View.
pere.chineseText: 如果读者对此存疑，不妨读一读奥斯诺老爹那本非常精彩的回忆录《特别好的视角》。

piste.englishText: In February 2012, Friso was skiing off-piste in Lech, Austria, when he was hit by an avalanche.
piste.chineseText: 2012年2月，弗里索在奥地利莱赫滑野雪时遭遇雪崩。

pleaser.englishText: The second is the people-pleaser, full of enthusiasm for culture and perks, with little clarity about what any of it means or what the business gets in return.
pleaser.chineseText: 第二类是讨好者，对文化和福利充满热情，却不太清楚这一切意味着什么、企业又能得到什么回报。

post-impressionism.englishText: She collected art, and was particularly interested in Impressionism and Post-Impressionism.
post-impressionism.chineseText: 她收藏艺术品，尤其偏爱印象派和后印象派。

post-mortem.englishText: The post-mortem on the child revealed that she had been poisoned.
post-mortem.chineseText: 对那名儿童的验尸显示她是被毒死的。

pre-atomic.englishText: He advised them that defence policies in pre-atomic bomb terms were now useless.
pre-atomic.chineseText: 他告诉他们，按原子弹时代之前的思路制定的防务政策如今已毫无用处。

pre-emption.englishText: Existing shareholders will have pre-emption rights.
pre-emption.chineseText: 现有股东将享有优先购买权。

pre-exist.englishText: These are all issues that pre-existed the pandemic.
pre-exist.chineseText: 这些都是疫情之前就已存在的问题。

prix.englishText: Her newly opened bistro does a prix-fixe lunch for under £20.
prix.chineseText: 她新开的小酒馆提供不到20英镑的固定套餐午餐。

pro-choice.chineseText: 在堕胎问题上的支持选择立场。

pubescent.englishText: Burrall was one of the actors who portrayed the Thriller singer, showcasing his pre-pubescent years.
pubescent.chineseText: 伯罗尔是饰演那位《Thriller》歌手的演员之一，展现了他青春期前的岁月。

publicist.englishText: She got a letter from the magazine promising every publicist’s dream: guaranteed favorable coverage in its pages.
publicist.chineseText: 她收到杂志社一封信，许诺给予每个宣传人员梦寐以求的东西：在版面上保证有利报道。

quattrocento.englishText: Commissioned by the Swiss aristocrat, banker and diplomat Count James-Alexandre de Pourtalès, the building that bears his name was designed by Félix Duban, who gave the building a quattrocento-style facade inspired by Florentine palazzos.
quattrocento.chineseText: 这座以瑞士贵族、银行家兼外交官詹姆斯-亚历山大·德·波塔莱斯伯爵命名的建筑，由费利克斯·迪邦设计，其立面采用十五世纪风格，灵感来自佛罗伦萨宫殿。

re-echo.englishText: Her words re-echoed in his mind.
re-echo.chineseText: 她的话在他脑海里不断回响。

re-present.englishText: Cheques that have failed to clear should be re-presented within five days.
re-present.chineseText: 未能清算的支票应在五天内重新提交。

republish.englishText: The Star is republishing this 2015 story detailing one such case.
republish.chineseText: 《星报》重新刊发这篇2015年的报道，其中详述了一个此类案例。

roly-poly.englishText: a roly-poly baby who grew into a slender child
roly-poly.chineseText: 一个圆胖的婴儿，长大后成了瘦削的孩子。

rufous.englishText: The rufous-breasted blue flycatcher was photographed on Luzon Island, Philippines, after last being seen in 2008.
rufous.chineseText: 这种红胸蓝鹟自2008年上次被观测到后，最近在菲律宾吕宋岛被拍到。

saved.englishText: Don’t Be Dumb broke Spotify’s record as the most pre-saved hip-hop album on the platform with 1 million total pre-saves.
saved.chineseText: 《Don’t Be Dumb》以总计100万次预存，打破了Spotify平台上嘻哈专辑的预存纪录。

self-centered.englishText: His new wife is demanding and self-centered, with clear narcissistic traits.
self-centered.chineseText: 他的新婚妻子要求多、以自我为中心，带有明显的自恋特质。

self-image.englishText: It’s very easy to get a negative self-image and lose confidence.
self-image.chineseText: 人很容易形成消极的自我形象并失去信心。

self-pity.englishText: A wave of self-pity came over him.
self-pity.chineseText: 一阵自怜涌上他的心头。

self-serving.englishText: This analysis could be said to be self-serving rather than accurate.
self-serving.chineseText: 这种分析可以说是出于私利，而非准确客观。

semi-annual.englishText: The journal is published on a semi-annual basis.
semi-annual.chineseText: 这本杂志每年出版两期。

senorita.englishText: The cakes are filled with margarita butter cream and covered with vanilla butter cream and decorated like a pretty Mexican senorita’s skirt.
senorita.chineseText: 这些蛋糕以玛格丽特黄油奶油为馅，外覆香草黄油奶油，装饰得像墨西哥漂亮姑娘的裙子。

short-order.englishText: The bakery-café chain gets top ratings for delivery drivers and short-order cooks, among other jobs.
short-order.chineseText: 这家面包咖啡连锁店在外卖骑手、快餐厨师等岗位上获得了最高评价。

short-term.englishText: a short-term solution to the problem
short-term.chineseText: 该问题的短期解决方案。

slack-jawed.englishText: She just sat there slack-jawed, with nothing to say.
slack-jawed.chineseText: 她就目瞪口呆地坐在那里，一句话也说不出来。

smart-ass.englishText: Dudamel wins over even the smart-asses in the back by hearing and remembering, as well as embracing, everything.
smart-ass.chineseText: 杜达梅尔甚至征服了后排那些自以为是的家伙，他倾听、记忆并接纳一切。

socio-economic.chineseText: 来自不同社会经济背景的人。

spine-chiller.englishText: Despite its pulpy plot, this is a classy spine-chiller with a fine cast.
spine-chiller.chineseText: 尽管情节俗套，这仍是一部由优秀演员出演的上佳恐怖作品。

stick-in-the-mud.englishText: David Corenswet plays, quite literally, a stick-in-the-mud character.
stick-in-the-mud.chineseText: 大卫·科伦斯韦演的可以说是一个不折不扣的守旧人物。

stiff-necked.englishText: he was too stiff-necked to admit that “underlings” might have useful ideas
stiff-necked.chineseText: 他太固执，不肯承认“下属”也可能有有用的想法。

sugar-coat.englishText: There’s no way of sugar-coating it—the report predicts a grim future for the industry.
sugar-coat.chineseText: 粉饰也没用——报告预测该行业前景黯淡。

superhero.englishText: The people who do this dangerous work are real-life superheroes who deserve our gratitude.
superhero.chineseText: 从事这项危险工作的人是现实生活中的超级英雄，值得我们感激。

torsion.englishText: Front-wheel-drive versions use a simpler torsion-beam design.
torsion.chineseText: 前轮驱动版本采用更简单的扭力梁设计。

trigon.englishText: The film will be released in Swiss cinemas by trigon-film.
trigon.chineseText: 这部电影将由trigon-film公司在瑞士影院发行。

wright.englishText: The stone-built mill, its wright's cottage and one-storey extension have been redesigned.
wright.chineseText: 这座石造磨坊、其工匠小屋和单层加建部分都已重新设计。
